answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 5386 Country: India Title: How should i pray salatul haajat that is method of praying the salah? Question: How should i pray salatul haajat that is method of praying the salah? Answer ID: 5386 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 727/687=D/1429) One should perform two rakah nafl salah after making fresh ablution. Having recited praise of Allah and durood on the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) , supplicate to Allah Almighty with so submission and humbleness saying: لا اله الا الله الح ل يم الكريم سبحان الله رب العرش العظیم الحمد رب العالمين، اسألك موجبات رحمتك و عزائم مغفرتک والغنيمه من كل بر و السلامه من كل اثم لا تدع لی ذنبا الا غفرته ولا هما الا فرجته و لا حاجۃ من حوائج الدنيا لك فيھا رضا الا قضيتها يا ارحم الراحمین In-sha-Allah, your needs would be fulfilled after doing so for some days. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
